correctness.rationale: Acyclicity makes nonstationary pair commutativity equivalent to both products being zero; permitted vertex idempotents are exactly those outside used sources/targets. Maximality forces all paths across a supported disjoint cut, giving unique classification and exact size polynomial. Centralizers are counted by two disjoint path-endpoint sets. The line count follows from fixing first and last nonneutral colors; all boundary n>=1 and parallel edges covered. The standalone checker reproduced 79 DAG cases and line n<=6.

value.rationale: The object is the standard finite quiver path semigroup, and its complete inclusion-maximal commuting-family size spectrum is a natural invariant. The result separates reachability-controlled family numbers from path-multiplicity-sensitive sizes and gives exact centralizer census and a nontrivial ternary line count, rather than a handpicked finite case. No downstream paper-sized application is claimed.
